     terminal activity. This can help with pair programming, incident response, troubleshooting, and teaching. Care
     is needed because everyone in the session may be able to view sensitive output or enter commands.                  Terminal multiplexer benefits

     Finally, multiplexers work almost everywhere because they are lightweight terminal programs. They do not           Context
     require a graphical desktop, consume few resources, and are practical on remote Linux systems. Learning a few      8,574 tokens
     commands for creating panes, switching windows, detaching, and reattaching can save significant time. For          2% used
     people who spend much of their day in a shell, a terminal multiplexer turns a single terminal into a durable,      $0.00 spent
     organized workspace.
